curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the equipment that must work, then the order of adjustments before starting and checks before moving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per check; a contrast card for before starting versus before moving.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about required equipment and the order of pre-drive steps.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why Arizona weather makes tires important, then the free inspection, the pressure check and the penny test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each tire rule; the pressure check and its contrast are taught on the penny test card.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about how to check pressure and tread.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach who must be belted and the driver's duty for young passengers, then what each part of the belt protects.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each belt rule; contrast cards for front-seat versus under-sixteen duties and lap versus shoulder protection.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about who must buckle up and why.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the child restraint ages and height, carrying several children, restraint standards, then air bag and front-seat rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each restraint rule; contrast cards for the under-five and five-to-eight rules and the front-seat age.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about a child's age, height and seat.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show what the travel information line and website report and how to use them for free.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each service feature; a contrast card for the cost.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about what the line reports and how to navigate it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the driver's duty for a safe vehicle, maintenance and emission re-checks, secured loads and brake requirements.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the thirty-day re-check, the load rule and car versus motorcycle brakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about brake systems, emission deadlines and loads.
